newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB KEEPS RAISIO TARGET.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB KEEPS RAISIO TARGET.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston analyst Anne Alexandre said on Wednesday she was keeping a 900 markka target price for Finnish food group Raisio after its presentation on its U.S. plans for cholesterol-cutting Benecol.
"I think that it (the share) has potential to go much higher," she told Reuters when the stock was at 555 markka in Helsinki.
She said her target period was hard to specify given volatility in Raisio -- it closed up 30 percent on Tuesday, but would be about 18 months to two years.
"The presentation showed very very strong potential for Benecol in the U.S.," Alexandre said, maintaining a "buy" recommendation on Raisio. She set the 900 markka target about six months ago.
Raisio made presentations to analysts and fund managers in London following an announcement on Tuesday that it had chosen Johnson&Johnson firm McNeil to market Benecol in the United States.
At 1450/1150 GMT, its stock was up 77 markka or over 16 percent at 555.00 after earlier soaring to 580.00 markka.
